text: With two scrambled alphabets, design 2 noticed planted English against copies of itself 5 times in 5 at length 13 and 4 in 5 at 16 (0143). The same comparison is now made for the carved text.
12 copies of K4 keep its carved letters at the 24 known places and shuffle the other 73; one exact pair of alphabets fits them all and starts every search.
K4 ranks 13 of 13 at length 13 and 7 of 13 at 16: both lengths closed at the measured strength.
